paleography.indonesian_translation: Semoga tiada rintangan dan berhasil. Obat sakit perut (wtĕng lara), sarana: pucuk dapdap, pucuk kacemcem, seseb (irisan halus) dibakar dalam abu hangat (tambus), ramuannya: ketumbar, iris-irisan tipis, disangrai, lalu disemburkan. Sembur kepalanya, sarana: gahmangan, o, ngiris, beras, dihaluskan, dipanaskan, dihangatkan, dibalurkan/ditempelkan. Obat tiwang labur, sarana: poh gedang (pepaya), terasi, diminum. paleography.english_translation: May there be no obstacles and success achieved. Medicine for stomachache (wtĕng lara), ingredients: shoots of dapdap, shoots of kacemcem, sliced and roasted in warm ash, adjuvants: coriander, thin slices, roasted, then sprayed/spit out (sembar). Medicine for heat/swelling of the skin (sbah akbus ring carmma), ingredients: all kinds of shoots, adjuvants: onion, candlenut, sliced, all roasted, sprayed. Spray for the head, ingredients: gahmangan, o, ngiris, rice, ground, heated until warm, applied. Medicine for tiwang labur, ingredients: poh gedang (papaya), shrimp paste, drank. The spray, ingredients: pacang lepas, pahiduh leaves, sliced and roasted in warm ash, babolong. The powder/paste, ingredients: bark of bohok, bark of bintaro, chili.

paleography.indonesian_translation: Om awighnam astu nama siddham. Inilah tata cara pengobatan anak-anak (usadha rare), hendaknya dipahami oleh para pengabdi ajaran Dharma. Adapun jika seorang bayi lahir, perhatikan tanda-tanda kelemahan pada sang bayi, serta tangan dan kakinya, begitu pula pandangan matanya. Jika bagian putih matanya tampak membiru, tangan dan kakinya dingin, tangisannya serak/tertahan, serta sayu mengantuk dan tubuhnya dingin demikian, nama sakitnya adalah 'blahan'. Obatnya, sarananya: sembung, beras merah, gamongan, ditempelkan pada ubun-ubunnya (blahan). Dan untuk bedak/boreh tangan serta kakinya, sarananya: buah pinang/sirih (bwah base), nekuning, wangkongsari, jabuggarum, pesgadubang, dibedakkan/dibalurkan, jangan terburu-buru memandikan bayi tersebut. Serta untuk bagian depannya (dadanya), sarananya: umbi tumpuk (humbin tuntung), bawang dibakar...
paleography.english_translation: Om awighnam astu namas siddham. This is the guideline for pediatric medicine (usadha rare), to be understood by those devoted to Dharma. When an infant is born, do not overlook the vital signs of the infant, as well as the hands and feet, and the gaze of the eyes. If the whites of the eyes appear bluish, the hands and feet are cold, the crying is strained/hoarse, and the eyes look drowsy while the body feels cold like that, the illness is called 'blahan'. The remedy, ingredients: sembung, red rice, gamongan, applied as a poultice to the fontanelle/blahan. And for the powder/balm for hands and feet, ingredients: betel nut/areca (bwah base), nekuning, wangkongsari, jabuggarum, pesgadubang, applied as a powder/balm; do not bathe that child hastily. And for the front (chest), ingredients: tip/sprout tuber (humbin tuntung), roasted shallots...

paleography.indonesian_translation: 1. Inilah ciri-ciri kucing, baik buruknya rupa serta perilakunya. Jika ada kucing sewarna bulunya, bercorak cundang di sela alisnya, segala jenis cundang, berpusar di ketiak kiri dan kanan, serta satu di dagunya, khasiatnya tidak akan didatangi oleh orang jahat, niat buruk orang akan batal karenanya; bila ada santet atau guna-guna yang mengganggu, akan musnah olehnya, demikianlah keutamaannya. Kucing berbulu hitam, keempat kakinya berbelang/bercincin, ekornya bundel (buntel), itu bertanda baik, khasiatnya mendatangkan kebahagiaan dan kekuasaan, tidak kekurangan harta. Kucing seluruh badannya hitam, lambung kirinya bertotol putih, terlebih lagi jika ekornya bundel, dinamai Wulan Karahinan, bertanda baik, apa pun yang dikehendaki akan berhasil. Kucing seluruh badannya putih, lambung kanannya bertotol hitam, terlebih lagi jika ekornya bundel, dinamai Wulan Purnama, bertanda baik, khasiatnya mendapatkan kebahagiaan terus-menerus. Kucing putih badannya, kepalanya hitam, ekornya bundel, bertanda baik, dinamai Bhujangga Hamengku, khasiatnya memiliki keutamaan yang besar.
paleography.english_translation: 1. These are the characteristics of cats, the good and bad of their appearance and behavior. If there is a cat of a single coat color, with cundang markings between its brows, any form of cundang, with swirls under its left and right armpits, and one on its chin, the result is that one will not be approached by malicious people, and evil human intentions will be thwarted by it; if there is sorcery or female spirits causing trouble, they will be neutralized by it, such is its virtue. A cat with black fur, all four legs striped/ringed, and a kinked/bobbed tail, is auspicious; its outcome brings happiness and power, and one will not lack wealth. A cat whose entire body is black, with a white patch on its left flank, especially if its tail is bobbed, is called Wulan Karahinan, auspicious; whatever is intended will be achieved. A cat whose entire body is white, with a black patch on its right flank, especially if its tail is bobbed, is called Wulan Purnnama, auspicious; its outcome brings continuous happiness. A cat whose body is white, its head black, and its tail bobbed, is auspicious, called Bhujangga Hamengku; its outcome brings great virtue.
